# atlassian_jira_field_scheme (Data Source)

Reads a Jira field scheme by ID using the experimental Field schemes API. Requires Administer Jira.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_jira_field_scheme" "existing" {
  id = "10000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Field scheme ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Scheme description.
- `name` (String) Scheme name.
